newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - 3Com reiterated as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - 3Com reiterated as hold.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Peter Swartz said he reiterated a hold rating on 3Com Corp.
-- said 3Com's proposed merger with U.S. Robotics Corp has "near-term issues that cloud long-term strategic positives," but strategic rationale behind the deal is very sound.
-- said would not formally change earnings estimates for 3Com until after the closing of the merger.
-- said set a preliminary earnings estimate for fiscal 1998 of $2.57 a share, which includes about $0.16 a share of "synergies" from the planned merger.
-- Previously, Swartz's estimate for 1998 was $2.60 a share.

-- said remains concerned about two key issues regarding the "new" 3Com: uncertainty regarding its adapter card business, and the aggressive pricing environment in the low-end stackable hub and switch markets, which could hurt 3Com's revenue growth and gross margins.
-- said product and sales integration issues are often larger than anticipated, and this could "introduce significant disruptions to the momentum of both 3Com and U.S. Robotics at a critical time."
-- said the timing of the deal "makes absolutely no sense" since both stocks are down about 50 percent from their highs.
-- said it was odd for U.S. Robotics to sell before its new x2 technology begins to contribute to revenues.
-- said expects 3Com to reduce overlapping research and development expenditures.
This could reduce R&D expenditures as a percentage of total sales by 40 basis points on a combined basis, Swartz said.
